We should not (b) lead a lazy life. We should all (c) build up our country. For this reason, we have to (d) work hard. No nation can prosper without industry. We should (e) remember that industry is the key to success. If we (f) idle the days away, we (g) lag behind. The nations that (h) are industrious (i) reach the pinnacles of development. So, we should (j) follow them.
